notes.title: Patch 1.10.1
notes.content:
A minor update was recently released to address some feedback issues.

Certain puzzles in the beginning are a little bit easier to understand and navigate now.

Also, the mouse look settings were moved in the main Settings screen. You can find the mouse look options in "Settings > Look".

I am compiling a demo version of TSM, which should be out in the upcoming days.
